create_adb_log_stream: create an AdbLogStream instance with an adb command prefix list to manage emulator logcat output
get_stream_output_adb_logcat: call get_stream_output on AdbLogStream to yield logcat lines as a generator from the emulator
stop_adb_log_stream: call stop_stream on AdbLogStream to kill the running adb logcat subprocess
set_log_filters_adb: call set_log_filters on AdbLogStream to filter which logcat tags are captured from the emulator
pause_resume_adb_log_stream: call pause_stream or resume_stream on AdbLogStream to control whether log lines are yielded
